scope: Notification deeplinks, wallet top-up/withdraw/deposit draft, numeric fields, attendance reversal, feedback report. Mock-only localStorage Next.js 16 MVP, no backend.

details.title: PostCSS XSS via unescaped </style> in CSS stringify output
details.reason: Fix requires `npm audit fix --force` which downgrades next to 9.x (major breaking change). Build-time CSS tooling, not an app runtime input path. Carried over from CS6; tracked for a coordinated Next/postcss upgrade.

findings.observation: Notifications are filtered by recipient userId in every surface (bell + dashboard cards). A wallet/dispute/application deeplink only opens the recipient's own dashboard modal; it never exposes another user's data because the target page reads only the authenticated user's slice.
findings.evidence: NotificationBell/DashboardNotificationCard filter on currentUserId; wallet modal reads getBalance(currentUserId).

findings.observation: Top-up / withdraw act on the authenticated user's own wallet only (userId passed from the role-guarded dashboard). Withdraw guard rejects over-balance / invalid amounts in the store (cannot be bypassed by a direct call). Unauthenticated users are redirected from role-guarded dashboards.
findings.evidence: walletStore.withdraw INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE/INVALID_AMOUNT guards; e2e/20 Part 8 unauth redirect.

findings.observation: Draft shifts (status 'Draft', escrow 'PendingDeposit') are excluded from the public listing (domain/filter requires status in {Published, FullyBooked} AND escrow 'Deposited'), so workers and other employers never see an employer's unpaid draft.
simulateDeposit guards balance < depositAmount BEFORE any mutation; a direct/programmatic call cannot publish a shift without funds and leaves no ghost Published shift.
findings.evidence: e2e/21 Part 2 + e2e/20 Part 4 (no ghost shift).

findings.observation: Mark-present/absent and the new absent→present reversal live on the employer's own shift detail (RoleGuard role=employer + shift.employerId === currentUserId). A worker cannot mark themselves present; an employer cannot act on another employer's shift (the page 404s on ownership mismatch).
Report reason / note and feedback comments are rendered as React text (auto-escaped). An payload in a feedback comment does not execute and creates no injected element.
Phone fields strip non-digit characters on input and validate via isValidVNPhone; amount/headcount fields strip to digits. A malicious string is reduced to inert digits before it reaches the store.

knownLimitations: Mock-only architecture: all authz is client-side (no server). A user can edit their own localStorage via devtools. Acceptable for a no-backend demo; real server-side authorization remains a known pre-existing deferred item.
Review reports are visible to any admin (mock). No per-admin scoping — acceptable for the MVP admin role.
